title: Considerations on the mechanisms of integration of the dead in the early sedentary societies of the Near East (Natufian, 15-11.6 ka cal BP)
version: Bulletins et mémoires de la Société d’Anthropologie de Paris 34(1), pp. 15–28
lineage: Published text read in its OpenEdition PDF rendering. Used for the early phase chronology.

passages.note: The regional Early Natufian range is given as 13–11.6 ka cal BC. The period range provides chronological context for Shelter 1 and does not directly date any plaster sample.
